#!/bin/bash
# Deploy PrepNow Application # This script builds and starts all services with Docker Compose
echo "==========================================" echo "PrepNow Application Deployment" echo "=========================================="
# Check if Docker is installed if ! command -v docker &> /dev/null; then echo "Error: Docker is not installed. Please install Docker first." exit 1 fi
# Check if Docker Compose is installed if ! command -v docker-compose &> /dev/null && ! docker compose version &> /dev/null; then echo "Error: Docker Compose is not installed. Please install Docker Compose first." exit 1 fi
echo "" echo "Building and starting all services..." echo "This may take several minutes on the first run..." echo ""
# Build and start all services docker compose up -d --build
echo "" echo "Waiting for services to be healthy..." sleep 10
# Show service status echo "" echo "Service Status:" docker compose ps
echo "" echo "==========================================" echo "Deployment Complete!" echo "==========================================" echo "" echo "Services are available at:" echo " - Frontend: http://localhost" echo " - Auth Service: http://localhost:8080" echo " - Assessment Service: http://localhost:8081" echo " - Question Service: http://localhost:8082" echo " - Submission Service: http://localhost:8083" echo " - Notification Service: http://localhost:8086" echo " - RabbitMQ Management: http://localhost:15672 (guest/guest)" echo "" echo "To view logs: docker compose logs -f [service-name]" echo "To stop all services: docker compose down" echo "To stop and remove volumes: docker compose down -v" echo ""

#!/bin/bash
# Script to recreate all Docker volumes with correct schema # This script will: # 1. Stop all services # 2. Remove all volumes # 3. Create fresh volumes # 4. Restart services with proper initialization
set -e # Exit on any error
echo "================================================" echo "Starting Volume Recreation Process" echo "================================================"
# Step 1: Stop and remove all containers echo "" echo "Step 1: Stopping all containers..." docker-compose down
# Step 2: Remove all existing volumes echo "" echo "Step 2: Removing old volumes..." docker volume rm auth_data 2>/dev/null || echo " - auth_data already removed or doesn't exist" docker volume rm assessment_db 2>/dev/null || echo " - assessment_db already removed or doesn't exist" docker volume rm questions_db 2>/dev/null || echo " - questions_db already removed or doesn't exist" docker volume rm submission_data 2>/dev/null || echo " - submission_data already removed or doesn't exist" docker volume rm notification_data 2>/dev/null || echo " - notification_data already removed or doesn't exist" docker volume rm rabbitmq_data 2>/dev/null || echo " - rabbitmq_data already removed or doesn't exist" docker volume rm submission-files 2>/dev/null || echo " - submission-files already removed or doesn't exist"
# Step 3: Create fresh volumes echo "" echo "Step 3: Creating fresh volumes..." docker volume create auth_data docker volume create assessment_db docker volume create questions_db docker volume create submission_data docker volume create notification_data docker volume create rabbitmq_data docker volume create submission-files
echo "" echo "Volumes created successfully:" docker volume ls | grep -E "(auth_data|assessment_db|questions_db|submission_data|notification_data|rabbitmq_data|submission-files)"
# Step 4: Create network if it doesn't exist echo "" echo "Step 4: Ensuring network exists..." docker network create prepnow-network 2>/dev/null || echo " - Network already exists"
# Step 5: Start database services first echo "" echo "Step 5: Starting database services..." docker-compose up -d auth-db assessment-db question-db submission-db notification-db rabbitmq
echo "" echo "Waiting for databases to initialize (60 seconds)..." for i in {60..1}; do echo -ne " Waiting... $i seconds remaining\r" sleep 1 done echo ""
# Step 6: Check database health echo "" echo "Step 6: Checking database health..." echo " - Auth DB:" docker-compose exec -T auth-db pg_isready -U ravindra162 -d auth_service || echo " WARNING: Auth DB not ready yet" echo " - Assessment DB:" docker-compose exec -T assessment-db pg_isready -U ravindra162 -d assessment || echo " WARNING: Assessment DB not ready yet" echo " - Question DB:" docker-compose exec -T question-db pg_isready -U ravindra162 -d QuestionsDB || echo " WARNING: Question DB not ready yet"
# Step 7: Verify PostgreSQL schemas echo "" echo "Step 7: Verifying PostgreSQL schemas..." echo " - Auth DB schema:" docker-compose exec -T auth-db psql -U ravindra162 -d auth_service -c "\dn" 2>/dev/null || echo " Schema check pending..."
# Step 8: Start application services echo "" echo "Step 8: Starting application services..." docker-compose up -d
echo "" echo "Waiting for services to start (30 seconds)..." for i in {30..1}; do echo -ne " Waiting... $i seconds remaining\r" sleep 1 done echo ""
# Step 9: Show service status echo "" echo "Step 9: Service Status:" docker-compose ps
# Step 10: Show logs summary echo "" echo "================================================" echo "Volume Recreation Complete!" echo "================================================" echo "" echo "All volumes have been recreated with fresh data." echo "" echo "IMPORTANT NOTES:" echo "1. AuthService will automatically create the schema via init script" echo "2. AssessmentService and QuestionService use JPA auto-creation" echo "3. MongoDB databases will be created automatically on first connection" echo "4. You need to create an admin user in AuthService" echo "" echo "To create an admin user, run:" echo " ./create_admin_user.sh" echo "" echo "To view logs for any service:" echo " docker-compose logs -f [service-name]" echo "" echo "To check if all services are healthy:" echo " docker-compose ps" echo ""
